svg.title: Connection Pooling
svg.desc: Connection Pooling. Share a few database connections among many requests, so connection setup and per-connection memory stop limiting the database. Step 1, Too many connections: 800 connections hit max_connections = 100: 37 pods fail; a connection per checkout is 43× slower. Step 2, Why connections cost: Each connection is its own process: 6.4 ms to set up (TLS, SCRAM), about 1.7 MB of private memory. Step 3, Pooling in practice: PgBouncer in transaction mode: 800 client connections share 20 server connections at 4,007 tps. Step 4, What pooling breaks: Transaction pooling leaks session state to the next client and adds a hop; RDS Proxy pins instead.
